caseName: W. H. Tompkins Co. v. United States
caseNameFull: W. H. Tompkins Co., now Tompkins Motor Lines, Inc. v. United States
attorneys: James W. Wrape and Harold G. Hernly for appellant., Solicitor General McGrath and Daniel W. Knowlton for the United States and the Interstate Commerce Commission, appellees.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam:

The motion to affirm is granted and the judgment is affirmed. United States v. Carolina Freight Carriers Corp., 315 U. S. 475.

Mr. Justice Black, Mr. Justice Reed, and Mr. Justice Douglas are of the opinion that probable jurisdiction should be noted.
